Button.Rules: Applies to the next d20 test. Not with advantage/disadvantage. No rerolls (e.g. Halfling Lucky).

Notify.Armed: Your next d20 test uses the risky d20 ({count}× 1, {count}× 20).
Notify.Advantage: The risky d20 can't be used with advantage or disadvantage. The roll was made normally, the risky d20 stays armed.
Notify.RerollsRemoved: Rerolls (e.g. Halfling Lucky) don't apply to the risky d20.

Keybinding.Toggle: Arm / cancel risky d20 for the selected player

Count.Name: Number of ones and twenties
Count.Hint: How many faces of the risky d20 show a 1 and a 20. The neighbouring faces are removed: with 2 there is no 2 and no 19, with 3 also no 3 and no 18, and so on. The average stays 10.5.

OnlyD20Tests.Name: Only d20 tests
OnlyD20Tests.Hint: Only attacks, ability checks, skill checks and saving throws of the dnd5e system are affected. Off: every d20, including free rolls like /r 1d20.

ShowButton.Name: Show panel
ShowButton.Hint: Shows the GM the risky d20 panel above the player list. Players never see it.
